# Snails

Snails is the tall, lanky unicorn colt who usually accompanies the shorter, excitable Snips in G4's *Friendship Is Magic*. Initially a gullible comic-relief character, he eventually surprises Ponyville by becoming a championship buckball player. His human counterpart in *Equestria Girls: Rainbow Rocks* performs as **DJ Snazzy Snails**, alongside MC Snips; that is the human counterpart's stage persona, not a disguise worn by the pony. [Film transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/My_Little_Pony_Equestria_Girls%3A_Rainbow_Rocks).

[![Snails (right) and Snips — Hasbro Studios, Boast Busters](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2020/7/13/477807/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/477807)

- **Appearance:** Golden-yellow coat, aquamarine mane and tail, pale freckles, large ears, long legs, and a pink snail with a purple spiral shell as his cutie mark.
- **Name:** Snails is his spoken television name. Together with Snips, it echoes the nursery rhyme *What Are Little Boys Made Of?* His licensed merchandise name is **Snailsquirm**, documented in Hasbro's March 2014 [Ponyville Newsmaker figure set](https://toywiz.com/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic-character-collection-sets-ponyville-newsmaker-figure-set/); this is not an established spoken surname.
- **Speaking status:** Recurring speaking character, voiced in English by Richard Ian Cox (credited as Richard Cox in [season-six credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_six)).
- **Other appearances:** *The Show Stoppers* (S1E18), *The Mysterious Mare Do Well* (S2E8), *Ponyville Confidential* (S2E23), *Magic Duel* (S3E5), and *The Cart Before the Ponies* (S6E14). His human counterpart also appears in the 2013 *Equestria Girls* film. [Character retrospective](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2016/09/pony-spotlight-19-snails_19.html).

[![Snails with his buckball teammates — Hasbro Studios, Buckball Season](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2020/7/18/1406213/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/1406213)

## Important moments

- **Taking Trixie's boast literally** — [Boast Busters (S1E6)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BfbVDQe4yE0): Snails and Snips lure an Ursa Minor into Ponyville to see Trixie defeat it, forcing Twilight to intervene. Timestamp unavailable.
- **An unexpected natural athlete** — [Buckball Season (S6E18)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JbIx2afSePc): While carrying water, Snails casually catches stray balls and demonstrates the precision levitation that earns him a place alongside Fluttershy and Pinkie Pie. Timestamp unavailable.
- **Don't overthink it** — [Buckball Season (S6E18), transcript](https://transcripts.foreverdreaming.org/viewtopic.php?p=188227): His advice to stop worrying helps his teammates rediscover the fun of playing, turning his usual comic weakness into a genuine strength. Timestamp unavailable.
- **From class clown to celebrated athlete** — [Common Ground (S9E6)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zz2sYogrJeU): Snails and his teammates become the first Buckball Hall of Fame inductees, while Snips attempts to monetize his friend's newfound celebrity. Timestamp unavailable.
